reels.caption:
Don't Stay in Hotels in Morocco… Stay in a Riad 👇🏻👇🏻👇🏻

A traditional Moroccan Riad is a home typically hidden in alleyways with multiple stories centered around an open-air courtyard with a fountain.

Each riad is completely different but its typically filled with:
🫖 Mint Tea
🌸 BEAUTIFULLY Tiled Bathrooms
🐱 Cats (my favorite)
• 🥂Group Lounging Areas
🛏️ Cozy Bedrooms
🐢 Turtles (to keep the bad energy away)
🍳 And the best breakfast of your life (most are included in your stay!)

I booked my Riads through:
• @bookingcom
• @agoda
• Riad's Website

Pricing:
I found the riads to be VERY AFFORDABLE, with prices ranging from $75 to $175 per night (depending).
NOTE: shoulder season is a lot cheaper too!

Riad's Shown:
• Riad Jardin Secret @riadjardinsecret
• Riad Yasmine @leriadyasmine
• BE Marrakesh @bemarrakech
• Riad Dar Baraka

LMK if you have any questions!

Videos in Collaboration w/ @carly_wesolowski
